title: Wario Land 3
shortDescription: A puzzle-platformer where Wario’s unusual durability turns hazards into tools for opening paths through a dense, interconnected map.
highlights: Abilities and hazards are combined into route-based environmental puzzles
A non-linear map rewards returning with new tools and knowledge

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A particularly good Game Boy Color fit for players who want platforming organized around exploration and puzzle solving rather than speed alone.
